item.tib: mkha' 'gro dgongs 'dus snying gi thig le phyi ma'i don gnyer rnams kyis (kyi) gsang ba'i nor gegs sel bde ba'i sman mchog
item.coloph: ces mkha' 'gro snying thig dgongs pa rang grol gyi rgyud las/ gegs sel bde ba'i sman mchog 'di yang / phyi ma'i don gnyer rnams kyi snying nor du/ 'ja' tshon snying pos ka'u tshang nyi ma rang shar gyi sa gnas su sug bris bgyis pa'o//
